WITH rental_payment_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) as rental_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN payment p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),

average_rental_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) as avg_total
  FROM rental_payment_totals
),

above_average_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    rpt.store_id,
    rpt.rental_total,
    art.avg_total,
    rpt.rental_total - art.avg_total as beat_amount
  FROM rental_payment_totals rpt
  CROSS JOIN average_rental_total art
  WHERE rpt.rental_total > art.avg_total
)

SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(rental_total) as combined_payment_total,
  AVG(beat_amount) as avg_beat
FROM above_average_rentals
GROUP BY store_id
ORDER BY store_id
